The Prophet said to prompt those who are dying to say 'There is no god but Allah'.
Closing the dead Abu Salama's eyes, the Prophet said sight follows the departing soul, told the family to pray only for good as angels say amen, and prayed for him.
The Prophet said none then living on earth would survive a hundred years, and swore to it when asked about the Hour, whose knowledge he said is with Allah.
None should wish for death over hardship, but may ask to live while life is good and die when death is better; Anas and Khabbab refrained for this reason.
Whoever loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet him: at death the believer, given glad tidings, loves it, while the disbeliever, told of torment, dislikes it.
Three days before his death the Prophet said that none should die except hoping only good from Allah.
